**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js#L6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Take either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js#L7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat as off |

The other 8 lines are true deprecation warnings. `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `crypto.createCipher`, and 5 more. They are noise for now, but `crypto.createCipher` breaks at v5.

Want me to clear those next?
